ValidationRule.description: Prevent Name Update for ML User for Business RT Contacts
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = 'ANZ ML Standard User', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Organisation', OR( ISCHANGED(Salutation), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(MiddleName), ISCHANGED(Suffix) ) )
